From: desk

Hi scheduler,

I have not forwarded the handover from coordinator dated 2 October 2026 09:34 (Evergreen Office Supplies, bank-detail change to sort code 60-83-71, account 44019482, effective 3 October 2026, deadline 2026-10-03, priority 1).

It cites approval FD-0926. The approvals log holds FD-0926 for Evergreen Office Supplies, but the item it covers is EOS-1187, a payment of 310.00 GBP gross for 16 October 2026. It does not cover a change to Evergreen's payment details in the supplier master. The handover's item (the bank-detail change) is therefore not covered by FD-0926, so I cannot mark it approved.

Please confirm with the FD whether a bank-detail change for Evergreen Office Supplies has been approved and, if so, have it recorded in the approvals log under its reference with the item stated. The handover can then be passed on unchanged.

Desk
